recommendedTextbook.title: New General Mathematics for Senior Secondary Schools 2
recommendedTextbook.author: M.F. Macrae, A.O. Kalejaiye, Z.I. Chima, G.U. Garba

topics.topic: Logarithms of Numbers Less than 1: Characteristics and Mantissa Calculations
subtopics: Expressing decimal fractions in standard form A × 10^-n
Negative characteristics (bar notation: 1̄, 2̄, 3̄)
Logarithmic multiplication, division, powers, and roots using four-figure tables
objectives: Determine the characteristic and mantissa of numbers less than 1
Evaluate compound computations with negative characteristics using four-figure log tables
Solve physics and chemistry quantitative problems using logarithms

topics.topic: Approximations, Significant Figures and Percentage Errors
subtopics: Rounding off to specified significant figures and decimal places
Absolute error, relative error, and percentage error formulas
Percentage error = (Absolute Error / True Value) × 100%
objectives: Calculate limits of accuracy in physical measurements
Compute percentage error in experimental laboratory determinations and commercial trade

topics.topic: Algebraic Fractions: Undefined Fractions and Fractional Equations
subtopics: Conditions under which an algebraic fraction is undefined (setting denominator = 0)
Addition and subtraction of algebraic fractions with polynomial denominators
Solving fractional equations reducible to quadratic equations
objectives: Find the values of x for which algebraic fractions are undefined
Simplify complex algebraic fractions by factorizing quadratic terms

topics.topic: Simultaneous Linear and Quadratic Equations: Analytical & Graphical Solutions
subtopics: Systems consisting of one linear and one quadratic equation: y = mx + c and y = ax^2 + bx + d
Solving by substitution: expressing y in terms of x and substituting into the quadratic equation
Intersection of straight lines and circles: x + y = k and x^2 + y^2 = r^2
objectives: Solve simultaneous linear and quadratic systems yielding two pairs of coordinates
Interpret points of intersection graphically as solutions to simultaneous equations

topics.topic: Linear Inequalities in Two Variables and Linear Programming
subtopics: Graphing linear inequalities in two variables using solid or dashed boundary lines
Shading unwanted regions to identify the feasible region
Formulating objective functions and constraints for Nigerian business profit maximization
objectives: Graph systems of linear inequalities on Cartesian coordinate planes
Determine maximum profit coordinates within the feasible region using vertex evaluation

topics.topic: Chord Properties of Circles and Angle Subtended by Arcs
subtopics: Perpendicular from the center of a circle to a chord bisects the chord
Equal chords are equidistant from the center
Angle subtended by an arc at the center is twice that subtended at the circumference
objectives: Prove and apply circle chord theorems to calculate lengths and distances
Solve multi-step geometric angle problems using the center-angle theorem

subtopics: Evaluation on logarithms, algebraic fractions, simultaneous quadratics, and circle theorems
WASSCE diagnostic test
objectives: Assess pupil mastery against WAEC Senior Secondary benchmarks

topics.topic: Circle Theorems II: Angles in the Same Segment & Cyclic Quadrilaterals
subtopics: Angles in the same segment of a circle are equal
Angle in a semicircle is a right angle (90°)
Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary (sum to 180°)
Exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equals the interior opposite angle
objectives: Apply circle theorems to evaluate complex interconnected angle diagrams
State geometric reasons (theorems) alongside every step in mathematical proofs

topics.topic: Tangent Properties of Circles: Alternate Segment Theorem
subtopics: A tangent to a circle is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact
Tangents from an external point to a circle are equal in length
The alternate segment theorem and practical geometric proof
objectives: Prove and apply the alternate segment theorem
Solve geometric engineering problems involving belt drives and tangent wheels

topics.topic: Trigonometry: The Sine Rule and The Cosine Rule
subtopics: Derivation and statement of the Sine Rule: a / Sin A = b / Sin B = c / Sin C
Derivation and statement of the Cosine Rule: a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc Cos A
Solving non-right-angled scalene triangles
objectives: Apply the Sine Rule when given two angles and one side or two sides and a non-included angle
Apply the Cosine Rule when given two sides and an included angle or three sides

topics.topic: Bearings and Distances: Practical Maritime and Aviation Navigation
subtopics: Three-figure bearings (000° to 360°) measured clockwise from true North
Drawing accurate navigational sketch diagrams with North directional arrows
Applying the Sine and Cosine rules to solve two-step navigation problems in Nigeria
objectives: Translate verbal navigational flight paths into precise geometric sketches
Calculate direct distances and reverse bearings between Nigerian cities (e.g., Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt)

subtopics: Review of circle theorems, Sine/Cosine rules, bearings, and linear programming
Timed WASSCE past question drills
objectives: Complete 50 WASSCE exam questions under timed test conditions

subtopics: First Term Senior Secondary 2 Examination and script moderation
objectives: Complete SSS 2 General Mathematics Term 1 evaluation
